definitions.height_m: Maximum Y of actual wood/retained foliage above root ground Y=0; exclude root flare below ground. Also report wood-only height. Envelope height is a parameter, not a measurement.
definitions.dbh_m: Diameter at 1.3 m above root ground along dominant trunk, interpolating intersecting structural edge radii; report 2*radius as circular-equivalent centreline model proxy. Multi-stem at this plane is ambiguous and must be flagged, not summed. Sources using US breast height (~1.37 m) are approximate comparisons; retain measurement height.
definitions.crown_width_m: Maximum of X and Z retained-foliage AABB spans; also report both spans. Approximation to field maximum spread; do not use wood buttress or envelope width.
definitions.crown_base_m: Lowest retained foliage Y above ground; report live primary-branch insertion separately. Hanging foliage and branch insertion are different.
definitions.foliage_length_m: Base-to-tip longitudinal extent of each transformed blade or needle, excluding separately modeled petiole/peg; use actual geometry, not unscaled parameter. Report min/max and median.
definitions.foliage_width_m: Maximum blade width transverse to midrib; needle width is maximum cross-section span, not its length or its projected screen width.
definitions.branch_count: Biological axes beginning at forks, excluding trunk. Collapse degree-two chains; choose thickest child as axis continuation, tie-break by stable node index. Report this operational estimate separately from stored branch-run count and nodes.
definitions.branch_order: Trunk order 0; continuing dominant axis retains order, lateral at fork increases it by one. Histogram counts branch origins, not all nodes.
definitions.twig_count: Unique retained twig runs (NodeKind::Twig), each a terminal fine woody axis; does not imply one leaf.
definitions.foliage_units: Oak: one simple blade per instance. Spruce: one individual needle per instance; no fascicles or leaflets. Always report units_per_instance, pre-cull instances, retained instances, actual individual units and discarded units.
definitions.leaf_area_m2: Sum transformed triangle areas once for a single blade sheet; do not double for double-sided rendering. For a closed needle report total external surface area separately from one-view projected area. Neither is field occupancy.

profiles.context: Mature tree-form, healthy leaf-on, open-grown Pacific Northwest savanna/park; adequate site, no clipping, pollarding, shrubby variety or closed forest suppression. Winter image is branch-anatomy reference only.

height_m.note: Mature favorable-site range; wider OSU landscape range 12–27 m is contextual, not substituted.

dbh_m.note: Approximate mature diameter comparison; 1.3 m model plane vs source US DBH convention.

crown_width_m.note: No context-matched biological range located; report actual value without a pass claim.

crown_width_height_ratio.note: Engineering estimate around documented width comparable to height, informed by uncalibrated photo. Not a measured population interval.

crown_base_m.note: No context-matched biological range located; report actual value without a pass claim.

foliage_width_m.note: 2–5 inches; no joint length-width distribution. Avoid independently sampling biologically implausible combinations.

anatomy.element: Single pinnately lobed blade with rounded lobes, rounded terminal lobe, visible narrow petiole connection; no bristle tips. Lobe count is contextual (sources differ), not a hard identity count.
anatomy.attachment: Alternate individual leaves along local twig; blade bases connect to twig by petiole, not floating clusters.
anatomy.branching: Short substantial bole, multiple heavy ascending/spreading crooked limbs, irregular rounded crown; natural irregularity must remain possible with supernatural effects disabled.

rubric.crown_silhouette: Broad rounded outline, not narrow pointed crown; O-WHOLE.
rubric.branching_habit: Substantial low primary limbs spread and bend irregularly, fine branching subdivides their ends; O-BARE.
rubric.crown_gaps: Irregular windows between foliage-bearing limbs, no uniform shell or sparse upward whiskers; O-WHOLE.
rubric.terminal_taper: Thick limbs reduce to fine twigs without abrupt stumps, bead-like joints or needles of wood; O-BARE.
rubric.foliage_shape_attachment: Rounded lobes and alternate attached individual blades visible at detail scale; O-LEAF.
